name: record-browser-gif
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：record-browser-gif。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Record browser or Web UI interaction demos as optimized GIFs using the available built-in browser, state-based frame capture, and deterministic encoding, then publish to a dedicated assets branch when the task includes attaching the GIF to a pull request. Use when asked to make, record, or generate a GIF that demonstrates a browser workflow, and for every pull request that changes product-user-vis
